subject: general
question: Which two initiatives were launched by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya to empower unorganized workers and enhance employment generation?

options.text: Labour Welfare Microsites and Employment Guarantee Scheme
e-Shram Microsites and Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)
Digital Skill Development Program and Employment Index
National Skill Development Mission and Labour Integration Portal

solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Shram Microsites and Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya launched two initiatives: e-Shram Microsites and the Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) to aid unorganised workers and enhance employment generation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The e-Shram Microsites are state-specific platforms that provide seamless access to Central and State government welfare programs for unorganised workers.**
 
• The Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) helps match labour market demand and supply by providing data-driven insights into occupations facing shortages.
 
• The OSI will aid policymakers and training institutions in aligning job seekers' skills with industry demands, bridging skill gaps in high-demand sectors.
 
• The initiatives are aimed at making the workforce future-ready and improving employment outcomes across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• e-Shram Microsites__

 __
 
• The e-Shram initiative aims to provide social security benefits to unorganised workers and improve transparency and efficiency in welfare service delivery.
 
• The microsites are integrated with the national e-Shram database and facilitate simplified registration for workers.
 
 
 
• Occupational Shortage Index (OSI)__
 
 
• The OSI is designed to provide real-time insights into labour shortages and help match job seekers' skills with industry demands.
 
• The index is based on data from the International Labour Organization (ILO) and quarterly data from the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS).
